Studio: fix Final Cut Pro audio connections and roles (#90)

Footage audio stays with its own picture in Final Cut Pro exports; audio roles follow Studio's row numbers; stems get dialogue (Voice, Footage), effects and music roles; volume keyframes import with their fades.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+---
+"openfilm": patch
+"@openfilm/desktop": patch
+---
+
+Keep footage audio connected to its own picture in Final Cut Pro exports, preserving source trims, volume and disabled audio. Export separate sound as audio-only clips.
+
+Match exported audio roles to Studio’s displayed row numbers, including overlapping clips and empty rows, and assign dialogue, effects and music roles to mixed stems. Keep Voice and Footage in separate dialogue subroles so they can be soloed and exported independently.
+
+Write audio volume keyframes without unsupported interpolation attributes so Final Cut Pro imports faded audio correctly.
